subject: Issues running Nimble after transferring to new silicon Mac (from previous Intel machine)

messages.author: ca6547b023c013bf
messages.subject: Issues running Nimble after transferring to new silicon Mac (from previous Intel machine)
parts:
Hi all,

I've just transferred my old computer to a new MacBook Pro M2 Max computer from a previous Intel-based one.

I have re-installed XCode, R, RStudio, Nimble, but am still receiving the following error when running nimbleMCMC(). I think it must be to do with the transition from Intel to Apple Silicon (it mentions 'x86_64', and 'arm64')

Defining model
Building model
Setting data and initial values
Running calculate on model
  [Note] Any error reports that follow may simply reflect missing values in model variables.
Checking model sizes and dimensions
Checking model calculations
Compiling
  [Note] This may take a minute.
  [Note] Use 'showCompilerOutput = TRUE' to see C++ compilation details.
Error in dyn.load(basename(ssDllName), local = TRUE) :
  unable to load shared object '/private/var/folders/tn/k9ywnh4n1lg_ctspwh5qvmrc0000gq/T/RtmpcKUgkf/nimble_generatedCode/dynamicRegistrations_03_20_09_38_14.so':
  dlopen(/private/var/folders/tn/k9ywnh4n1lg_ctspwh5qvmrc0000gq/T/RtmpcKUgkf/nimble_generatedCode/dynamicRegistrations_03_20_09_38_14.so, 0x0006): tried: '/private/var/folders/tn/k9ywnh4n1lg_ctspwh5qvmrc0000gq/T/RtmpcKUgkf/nimble_generatedCode/dynamicRegistrations_03_20_09_38_14.so' (mach-o file, but is an incompatible architecture (have 'x86_64', need 'arm64')), '/System/Volumes/Preboot/Cryptexes/OS/private/var/folders/tn/k9ywnh4n1lg_ctspwh5qvmrc0000gq/T/RtmpcKUgkf/nimble_generatedCode/dynamicRegistrations_03_20_09_38_14.so' (no such file), '/private/var/folders/tn/k9ywnh4n1lg_ctspwh5qvmrc0000gq/T/RtmpcKUgkf/nimble_generatedCode/dynamicRegistrations_03_20_09_38_14.so' (mach-o file, but is an incompatible architecture (have 'x86_64', need 'arm64'))

Any help or suggestions very welcome!

Thanks.

Robbie

I assume you have installed the arm64 version of R?

-chris

Robbie
